name: aiops
description: The CloudWatch investigations feature is a generative AI-powered assistant that can help you respond to incidents in your system.

subcommands.name: create-investigation-group
subcommands.description: Creates an investigation group in your account.

subcommands.name: delete-investigation-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified investigation group from your account.

subcommands.name: delete-investigation-group-policy
subcommands.description: Removes the IAM resource policy from being associated with the investigation group that you specify.

subcommands.name: get-investigation-group
subcommands.description: Returns the configuration information for the specified investigation group.

subcommands.name: get-investigation-group-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the JSON of the IAM resource policy associated with the specified investigation group in a string.

subcommands.name: list-investigation-groups
subcommands.description: Returns the ARN and name of each investigation group in the account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Displays the tags associated with a CloudWatch investigations resource.

subcommands.name: put-investigation-group-policy
subcommands.description: Creates an IAM resource policy and assigns it to the specified investigation group.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-investigation-group
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of the specified investigation group.
